definitions.explanation: The quality of being consistent throughout; logical connection between parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: To maintain consistency in one's argument.

examples.japanese: {一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。

notes:
{一貫性|いっかんせい} refers to logical consistency or coherence—maintaining the same principles, methods, or standards throughout.

ETYMOLOGY:
Formed from ⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：17700_ikkan_b⟧ (consistency, coherence) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). ⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：17700_ikkan_b⟧ literally means 'one thread running through.'

- {一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have consistency
- {一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧/⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack consistency
- {一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain consistency
- {一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to give/ensure consistency
- {一貫性|いっかんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: consistent response

USAGE:
Used in discussions of policy, arguments, behavior, design, and data.
